current.service_desc:
Portal26 is an AI visibility, security, governance, and adoption management
platform. Portal26 provides a SaaS application for Agentic, Generative and Embedded
AI governance and adoption, together with AI network gateways for
real-time traffic routing and analysis.

The platform gives agencies detailed visibility into AI
deployment, usage, risk, cost, business value, compliance, and overall impact — enabling 
a rich understanding where and how AI is used, ensure its security, assess its contribution,
and ensure alignment with mission objectives, regulations, and policy.

The FedRAMP offering is deployed in AWS GovCloud (US) for direct use by
federal agency customers handling Controlled Unclassified Information
(CUI). Federal customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and
personally identifiable information is additionally encrypted at the field
level under a key specific to each customer.
